h1: Cagrilintide with retatrutide: what the evidence covers
dek: No human trial has tested cagrilintide with retatrutide; the only study of the pair is in obese male rats. This page reports each drug's own trial doses separately, retatrutide's phase 3 status and what is known by sex.
scope: Informational only. No dosing instructions, no vendors or prices.

competitors.gap: Presents the pair as a 'stack' without stating that no human trial has tested it; no citation of the 2026 rat study or of TRIUMPH results
Seller-adjacent beginner guide to a blend; no trial evidence for the combination exists to support a guide, and no sex-specific data
Primary retatrutide phase 2 paper; says nothing about cagrilintide and is not written for the combination query
competitors.source: Semrush top-10; not fetched (paper text read via a PDF copy for the sex subgroup)

competitors.gap: Frames the two as alternatives; no statement of each drug's regulatory status as of 2026

information_gain: The only page to cite the one published study of the pair (obese male rats, Nature Metabolism, September 2026), set each drug's trial doses side by side without blending them, answer the 'for men' query with retatrutide's phase 2 sex subgroup (women 28.5%/26.6% vs men 19.8%/21.9%), and give retatrutide's TRIUMPH-1 to 3 results with Lilly's Q1 2027 U.S. filing plan.
serp_format_rewarded: AI Overview plus forum and seller pages; an evidence explainer with a separate-doses table and a plain 'no trial' statement answers what the AI Overview and sellers blur.
